subject: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap & evidentiary timeline
messages:
From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@betahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap & evidentiary timeline

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. Our security & compliance team at BetaHealth is preparing an external supplier assessment and we need a concise roadmap from Redwood covering ISO 27001 plans, FedRAMP readiness, and expected evidence delivery windows for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ. Specifically we need: 

- Clarify ISO 27001 scope (in-scope services, exclusions) and target certification quarter.
- FedRAMP posture: any work toward FedRAMP Low/Moderate, existing gap analysis or planned assessor engagement.
- A proposed timeline for producing key evidence: system architecture diagram, encryption/service keys, logging/audit samples, access control matrices, and personnel attestations.
- Which control owners we should expect to contact and typical lead times for evidence pulls (e.g., log retention windows, snapshot definition).

Can you return a short roadmap (1–2 pages) and an evidence inventory template? We’d like to get this before our internal vendor review on Nov 3.

If useful, we can schedule a 30 minute kickoff this week — Friday morning PT would work.

Regards,
Miguel Torres
Head of Vendor Risk, BetaHealth
Miguel.Torres@betahealth.com

--
Attachment: beta-vendor-questionnaire-excerpt.pdf (PDF)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@betahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap & evidentiary timeline

Miguel — thanks, this is clear and timely.

We can put together the roadmap and a pre-filled evidence inventory. High-level plan I propose:

1) Quick sync / kickoff call to confirm scope (15–30 min) — Fri Oct 22, 11:00am PT suggested.
2) Inventory sprint: Oct 25–Nov 5 — produce an evidence spreadsheet, system diagram, and control-owner roster.
3) Delivery: draft evidence bundle by Nov 6; final by Nov 10 to meet your Nov 3 review we may provide a prioritized subset earlier if needed.

I attached a short Compliance Overview that summarizes our current posture and where we are focusing ISO/FedRAMP work. I’ll coordinate internal owners (Karthik for infra/logs, Marissa for control mapping & CAIQ/SIG responses).

Attachment: redwood-compliance-overview.pdf (PDF)

If that timeline is aggressive for you, tell me which items you need first and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Security Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Forwarding BetaHealth ask and my reply — please see action items below. Miguel asked for a concise roadmap + evidence inventory before their vendor review on Nov 3.

Proposed internal assignments (please confirm):
- Karthik: infra evidence (network diagrams, system_diagram.pdf, encryption & key management details, logging/audit samples). Expect to pull 30/60-day log samples; clarify retention windows.
- Marissa: control mapping, SOC 2 scope confirmation, SIG/CAIQ owner responses, and questionnaire completion cadence.
- Sofia: external kickoff + consolidation, formatting the roadmap doc.

Deliverables and target dates:
- Evidence inventory (template filled) — Oct 28
- System architecture diagram (initial) — Oct 28
- Control-owner roster + contact list — Oct 27
- Prioritized evidence bundle for BetaHealth review — Nov 2

Questions for you both:
1) Karthik — do we have an up-to-date system_diagram.pdf and who on infra can sign off on encryption/KMS notes?
2) Marissa — will you take CAIQ/SIG lead and estimate completion time if we run a 1-week focused sprint?
3) Any blockers (access to logs, retention/export tooling, or people OOO) we should flag now?

I’ll create the shared Drive folder once you confirm.

--
